datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to collect Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data across Niger. The spatial classifications were compiled into geographic datasets representing different IPC scenarios for medium-term projections, with data aggregated by administrative areas and time periods (January-February 2022).
